annotations.title: Check facts in a draft against the records

description:
Check the facts of a draft (a capture brief, a market report, an e-mail) against the
    records before it goes out. Send each fact as a claim; each comes back `matches`, `differs`
    (with what the record says), `not_found` or `not_checked`, and the page that shows it. A
    dollar figure matches when the record rounds to the words it was stated in ("$4.2 billion"
    covers 4.15 to 4.25). Nothing is judged by an AI here: every claim is a lookup. Use it after
    writing, on the figures, dates, names, certifications and quoted rules the draft relies on;
    fix or drop what differs, and say what could not be checked.

claims.description: The facts to check, up to 25, each an object with `kind` and, optionally, `text` (the sentence it comes from). amount: {"kind": "amount", "plan": <QueryPlan>, "stated": "$4.2 billion"} (or "value": 4200000000; "row": "Leidos" picks a row of a ranking). notice: {"kind": "notice", "notice_id": "<id>", "deadline": "2026-12-01", "set_aside": "SDVOSB", "naics": "541512"}. contract: {"kind": "contract", "award": "<award key or number>", "incumbent": "Leidos", "end_date": "2027-03-31", "stated": "$12.5M"}. company: {"kind": "company", "company": "<UEI or name>", "certification": "8(a)", "state": "VA", "registered": true, "excluded": false}. far: {"kind": "far", "section": "19.502-2", "quote": "<words quoted>"}.
